textos.A maioria dos que recomendam destaca o t: Most of those who recommend it highlight the critical take on patriarchy and the pressures women face. In contrast, most of those who do not recommend it consider the feminist approach artificial, also pointing to a disjointed narrative structure with no defined direction.
textos.As críticas apontam que o filme martela: Critics point out that the film hammers its feminist message in an exaggerated way, leaving no room for interpretation, treating the audience as if it were not capable of understanding subtext.
textos.Roteiro confuso e sem direção clara: Confusing script with no clear direction
textos.Muitos espectadores reclamam que o filme: Many viewers complain that the film does not seem to know what it wants to convey, mixing so many ideas that the end result is confusing and without a defined purpose.
textos.Várias pessoas relatam que se entediaram: Several people report being bored at some moments, especially in the real-world part, even walking out of the theater or pausing the film.
textos.O filme é criticado por parecer um grand: The film is criticized for seeming like one big commercial, packed with mentions of brands and products, which makes it artificial and aimed only at profit.
textos.As reviews apontam que diversos personag: Reviews point out that several characters, especially the human ones, lack depth, being mere props to drive the plot.
textos.Embora muitos elogiem o desempenho de Ry: Although many praise Ryan Gosling's performance as Ken, other actors, including Margot Robbie and Will Ferrell, are criticized for performances considered forced or irritating.
textos.O filme tenta passar uma mensagem femini: The film tries to convey a feminist message, but ends up sounding superficial and shallow, leaving the impression that the social criticism is only a veneer.
textos.Os cenários, figurinos e a direção de ar: The sets, costumes and art direction are impressive and give the film a striking visual identity, being one of the production's strongest points.
textos.Atuações de Margot Robbie e Ryan Gosling: Performances by Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling
textos.O elenco se destaca, especialmente Ryan: The cast stands out, especially Ryan Gosling, who steals the show with his humor, and Margot Robbie, who conveys charisma and energy.
textos.Divertido, mas com ritmo irregular: Fun, but with an uneven pace
textos.O filme tem momentos divertidos e engraç: The film has fun, funny moments, but in some stretches the narrative loses its rhythm and becomes drawn-out, making the viewer lose interest.
textos.Alguns espectadores notam a contradição: Some viewers note the contradiction of a film that criticizes the system and consumption but is produced by Mattel itself, which weakens the message.
textos.Muitos foram ao cinema esperando uma his: Many went to the theater expecting a nostalgic, light story about the doll, but found a more serious approach with social commentary, which disappointed a portion of the audience.
textos.Crítica ao patriarcado e às expectativas: Criticism of patriarchy and expectations of women
textos.A review destaca o monólogo de America F: The review highlights America Ferrera's monologue as a powerful portrait of the contradictions and demands women face in society, such as having to be pretty but not showy, and successful without seeming ambitious.
textos.Uma review elogia a versatilidade de Rya: One review praises Ryan Gosling's versatility, highlighting his performance as Ken as one of the film's great standouts.
textos.A pessoa relata ter saído da sessão às l: The person reports leaving the screening in tears, because the film made them reflect on the difficulties of being a woman and the lack of freedom in the face of social expectations.
textos.Uma review descreve o filme como um espe: One review describes the film as a visual spectacle, praising the sets, costumes and art direction, which evoke a well-realized toy world.
textos.O autor menciona que o filme é divertido: The author mentions that the film is fun and funny, providing a great experience at the movies.
textos.Uma análise aponta que a abordagem femin: One analysis points out that the feminist approach is valid and important for starting discussions, although it acknowledges that works with deeper perspectives on the subject already exist.

textos.Dirigido por Greta Gerwig e lançado em 2: Directed by Greta Gerwig and released in 2023, the film Barbie blends elements of comedy, adventure and fantasy over its 114 minutes. The premise follows life in the magical world of Barbieland, where one of the dolls begins to notice she does not fit the standards of the others; expelled from that setting, she embarks on a journey through the real world and learns that true beauty lies within.
textos.A experiência cinematográfica articula u: The cinematic experience sets up a setting that contrasts the stylized aesthetics of a playful universe with the dynamics of urban space.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~70%), boa: Among the vast majority of ratings (~70%), a good portion of the accounts emphasize the criticism of patriarchy and the portrayal of women's pressures and expectations in society. Complementing that view, some praise the performances of Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling, while a smaller slice expresses a strong emotional impact and experiences of personal reflection during the screening.
textos.Para a perspectiva situada numa parcela: From the perspective found in a share of ratings (~22%), a significant share judges that the feminist message comes across as superficial or forced. Even so, several draw attention to the film's visual polish and production design, while a considerable number appreciatively highlight the performances of Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling.
textos.Antecipando um tom de forte descontentam: Anticipating a tone of strong discontent in a minimal fraction of ratings (~8%), many criticize the handling of a feminist discourse considered forced and unsubtle, frequently making comparisons to support the analysis. In that same range, a good portion argues that the film suffers from a confusing script with no clear direction, while a portion report moments of boredom at a slow pace.
